scope: Recorded executions before source cleanup; use the experiment commands and retained regressions to reproduce on the current revision. Counts cover declared requirements and incidents, not all network behavior.

vendors.FRR: ISP graphs, Clos, campus and enterprise within their declared model scopes.
vendors.Nokia SR Linux: ISP graphs and min3clos; restricted concrete-configuration projection plus native checks.
vendors.Cisco IOS XR: iosxr_simple_bgp: two-router direct eBGP; native Batfish parser and XRd execution.
vendors.MikroTik RouterOS: routeros_simple_bgp: two-router direct eBGP; restricted concrete-configuration projection plus native checks.

limitations: The 289 default profiles were not all executed natively; native ISP coverage is the 39 benchmark deployment profiles.
Cisco XRd and RouterOS do not have the general ISP coverage of FRR and SR Linux.
IS-IS uses a scoped single-level shortest-path reduction. FRR IS-IS with eBGP remains unsupported by the configuration projection.
Static-only acceptance carries no native execution claim. No universal analyzer/router equivalence or global convergence proof is claimed.
